title: Starting a Community Garden Toolkit
summary: Everything from finding land to your first workday: checklists, sample budgets and a 12-month plan.
body:
Step 1: Find the land. Start with the city's vacant land inventory and the land trust map in this toolkit.

Step 2: Form a group. You need at least five committed people before you approach a landowner. Use the sign-up sheet template.

Step 3: Budget. A typical first-year budget for a 20-plot garden is $6,500. The spreadsheet in this toolkit breaks it down line by line.

title: Land Use Agreement Template
summary: A plain-language agreement between a garden group and a landowner, reviewed by volunteer attorneys.
body: This template covers term, access, water, insurance, improvements and what happens if the land is sold. Edit the highlighted fields and have both parties sign.

title: Winterizing Your Plot (recording)
summary: The October members' webinar on cover crops, mulch and putting beds to rest.
body: Watch the 72-minute recording and download the slides. Chapters: cover crops (04:10), mulch (21:30), compost (38:00), questions (55:20).

title: Garden Insurance Explained
summary: What the Garden Group liability cover includes, what it doesn't, and how to make a claim.
body: The cover applies to public events and scheduled volunteer days. It does not cover tools, structures or crops. To make a claim, email the member services team within 30 days.

title: Volunteer Sign-Up and Waiver Forms
summary: Printable sign-up sheets and a waiver that works with the Garden Group cover.
body: Print the sign-up sheet for workdays and keep signed waivers for three years.

title: Seed Grant Application Guide
summary: How seed grants are scored, with two funded applications as examples.
body: Applications are scored on community need (40%), plan (30%), budget (20%) and sustainability (10%).

title: Soil Testing on a Budget (recording)
summary: A lab scientist explains what a $20 soil test tells you and when lead testing matters.
body: Watch the 48-minute recording. Includes a list of low-cost labs by state.

title: Chapter Leader Handbook
summary: Running meetings, finances and elections for a Commonground chapter.
body: The handbook covers chapter bylaws, the annual budget, how to run a fair election and how to hand over to the next lead.
